items.title: Ford blasts White House criticism of China tech partners, calls Duffy letter 'wrongheaded'
items.summary: Ford stock was volatile a day after the White House questioned its strategy of using Chinese partners. Ford responded after the bell in a forceful manner, hinting as possible behind the scenes drama.

items.title: Ford Faces ‘Profound Concern’ Over China Ties. What That Means for the Stock.
items.summary: The letter takes aim at Ford’s licensing of Chinese battery technology and joint venture with Chinese auto maker Geely in Europe.  “And the Company’s ongoing talks with  BYD  for hybrid vehicle components could lead to further embedding subsidized foreign technology into Ford’s core supply chains.”  Ford posted a response online challenging how some of Duffy’s concerns were framed.

items.title: General Motors’ Stock: Is GM Outperforming the Consumer Discretionary Sector?
items.summary: General Motors’ stock has outpaced the broader consumer discretionary sector over the past year, and analysts remain reasonably upbeat about its prospects.

items.title: How Much Longer Can Blue-Chip Companies Keep Up High Performance?
items.summary: Earnings per share for S&P 500 companies skyrocketed 53% from a year earlier in Q2 and sales jumped almost 16%, according to LSEG data.

items.title: GM, Ford Turn EV Battery Bust Into Energy Storage Bet
items.summary: Ford and GM are repurposing underused EV battery capacity for energy storage, seeking new revenue after taking billions of dollars in EV-related write-downs

items.summary: General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) reached a tentative three-year labor deal with Unifor that Canadian workers ratified on August 29 and 30, securing more than C$1 billion ($791 million) in new and previously announced investment across Ontario, covering over 4,600 workers. items.title: General Motors (GM) Has One Operational US EV Battery Plant
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) now has ownership in just one operational US electric vehicle battery plant as its North American manufacturing footprint shifts. The company is scaling back parts of its US EV battery production while keeping EV supply chain commitments under review. GM has committed a new C$144 million investment to expand pickup truck assembly in Canada, focused on higher margin models. items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 4: Tesla Falls After Cybercab Launch Disappoints Investors
items.summary: Today, Sept. 4, 2026, the electric vehicle maker's stock dropped 5.92% following its private Austin event, which left key autonomy questions unanswered.
